standard_prerequisites.name: A quasi-isomorphism between complexes induces a quasi-isomorphism of Hom complexes out of a bounded above complex of projectives
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies Hom(P, L) with Hom(P, I) in the derived category.

core_obligations: By the cohomology-hom-complex formula and the morphisms-from-projective-complex lemma of the derived categories chapter, the cohomology groups of the complex Hom(P, L) are the correct Hom groups in the homotopy category (proof lines 18717-18719). Choose a quasi-isomorphism L -> I with I K-injective; the induced map Hom(P, L) -> Hom(P, I) has correct cohomology on the source by the previous step and is therefore a quasi-isomorphism, and since the target Hom(P, I) is by definition RHom_R(P, L), the termwise Hom complex represents RHom_R(P, L) (proof lines 18720-18728).
proof_roadmap: Verify the cohomology groups of Hom(P, L) are correct via the formula and the projective-morphism criterion (proof lines 18717-18719).
Map into a K-injective resolution and conclude the induced map is a quasi-isomorphism (proof lines 18720-18728).
